facts.text: Audrey mentioned that her veggie patch is coming along and the flowers are looking great.

evidence.quote: It's going great! The flowers are looking great and my veggie patch is coming along. It's so fun to see them grow! Really feels accomplishing.

facts.text: Audrey identified the flowers in the photo as Peruvian Lilies, noting their bright colors and delicate petals.

evidence.quote: They're called Peruvian Lilies. They are so awesome - they have such bright colors and delicate petals.

facts.text: Audrey described the flowers as easy to care for, requiring only water and sufficient sunlight.

evidence.quote: Nope, they're easy to take care of, perfect for me! Just gotta water them and make sure they get enough sun.
